The '''1968–69 Serie A''' season was won by [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]].

==Teams==
[[US Palermo|Palermo]], [[Hellas Verona]] and [[Pisa Calcio|Pisa]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

==Events==
The [[goal difference]] was introduced for the relegations instead of the tiebreakers.
